title: Meeting Your Neighbor
objectives: Use simple 'to be' sentences (I am, you are)
Have a basic first conversation in English

phrases: I am good / I am fine
target_language.grammar_pattern:
I am [name]
I am from [place]
I am good

You are [name]
You are from [place]
You are good

Examples:
- I am Ahmed
- I am from Somalia
- You are Marcus
- You are from America

story.context: You are in the hallway of your apartment building. A man comes out of the apartment across from yours.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: My name is Ahmed. I am from Somalia. I live in 4B.

dialogue.speaker: You
dialogue.text: I am good. Thank you. How are you?

dialogue.speaker: Marcus
dialogue.text: I'm good. Welcome to the building!

drills.title: Drill 1: Read and Respond
drills.instruction: Someone asks you a question. Write your own real answer.

prompts.question: Marcus asks: "What is your name?" Write your answer.
Someone asks: "Where are you from?" Write your answer.
You meet a new neighbor for the first time. Introduce yourself: say your name AND where you're from.
prompts.model_answer: Hi! My name is Ahmed. I am from Somalia.

examples: Hi! My name is Sarah. I am from England.
drills.your_turn: Now introduce yourself out loud to a new neighbor (name + where you're from) and record it

drills.title: Drill 2: Notice the Pattern
drills.instruction: Use what you noticed about 'I am' and 'you are' to complete each sentence

prompts.sentence: Marcus says: "I am from America." Now talk about yourself: I ___ from Somalia.
You want to ask how Marcus feels. Ask him: "___ you good?"
Complete Marcus's reply: "I ___ good. Thank you."

examples: I am Ahmed. I am from Somalia.
drills.your_turn: Now say a full sentence about how YOU feel today, using 'I am ___', out loud and record it

drills.title: Drill 3: A New Neighbor
drills.instruction: Put it all together in a new situation

prompts.question: A neighbor knocks and says: "Hi! I'm Lisa. I live in 2A." Write a full reply: introduce yourself (name + where you're from) and say something polite.
prompts.model_answer: Hi Lisa! My name is Ahmed. I am from Somalia. Nice to meet you!

prompts.question: Lisa says: "Nice to meet you!" What do you say back?
Lisa asks: "How are you?" Write your answer.
prompts.model_answer: I am good, thank you. How are you?

examples: Hi! My name is Ahmed. I am from Somalia. Nice to meet you!
I am good, thank you. How are you?
drills.your_turn: Now act out the whole conversation with a new neighbor out loud and record it

listening.question: Listen: What is her name?
listening.transcript: Hello. My name is Sarah. Nice to meet you.

listening.question: Listen: Where is he from?
listening.transcript: Hi. My name is Marcus. I am from America.

listening.question: Listen: How is she?
listening.transcript: Hello. How are you? I am good, thank you.

speaking.title: Task 1: Introduce yourself
speaking.instruction: Record yourself saying: 'Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME]. I am from [YOUR PLACE].'
speaking.example: Hi, my name is Ahmed. I am from Somalia.

speaking.title: Task 2: Complete conversation
speaking.instruction: Imagine you meet Marcus. Record the full conversation from the story. You are 'You' in the dialogue.
speaking.example:
Person A: Hi!
Person B: Hello. My name is Ahmed. I am from Somalia.
Person A: Nice to meet you!
Person B: Nice to meet you too.

writing.title: Task 1: Fill in the blanks
writing.example:
1. My name is _____.
2. I am from _____.
3. I am _____. (good/fine/great)

writing.title: Task 2: Write a conversation
writing.instruction: Write a short conversation (6-8 lines) where two people meet for the first time. Use the phrases from this lesson.
writing.example:
Person A: Hi!
Person B: Hello.
Person A: My name is Sarah. I am from England.
Person B: Nice to meet you! My name is Ahmed.
Person A: Nice to meet you too. Where are you from?
Person B: I am from Somalia.
Person A: How are you?
Person B: I am good. Thank you.

sections.title: Look at these sentences:
sections.question: What do you notice? What comes after 'I'?
sections.explanation: All three sentences use 'I am'. We use 'I am' to tell people about yourself.

sections.title: Now look at these:
sections.question: What is different from the first group?
sections.explanation: When talking to someone else, we use 'you are' instead of 'I am'.

sections.title: What can come after 'I am' or 'you are'?
sections.question: Can you think of other things that could come after 'I am'?
sections.explanation: You can use 'I am' with your name, where you're from, how you feel, and many other things about yourself.

quiz.question: How do you tell someone your name?
quiz.explanation: We say 'My name is [name]'. This is the natural way to introduce yourself.

quiz.question: Someone says 'Nice to meet you.' What do you say?
quiz.explanation: 'Nice to meet you too' is the standard, polite response.

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: I ___ from Somalia.
quiz.explanation: We use 'am' after 'I'. So it's 'I am from Somalia.'

quiz.question: Fill in the blank: You ___ Marcus.
quiz.explanation: We use 'are' after 'you'. So it's 'You are Marcus.'

quiz.question: When Marcus says 'How are you?', what does he want to know?
options: How you feel / if you are okay
quiz.explanation: 'How are you?' is asking about how you feel or if you are doing well.

quiz.question: You want to ask about someone's feeling or condition. What do you say?
quiz.explanation: 'How are you?' is the standard question to ask about someone's well-being.

quiz.question: Which sentence is CORRECT?
quiz.explanation: The correct form is 'I am from Somalia'. We need 'am' after 'I'.

quiz.question: What does 'Hi' mean?
quiz.explanation: 'Hi' is an informal way to say hello and greet someone.

quiz.question: Write a 4-line conversation where you meet someone named Sarah from England. Use the phrases you learned.
quiz.explanation:
Your conversation should include greetings, names, and where you're from. Example:
Sarah: Hi! My name is Sarah.
You: Hello. My name is Ahmed.
Sarah: Nice to meet you. I am from England.
You: Nice to meet you too. I am from Somalia.

quiz.question: Think about the lesson. Write 2-3 sentences: What was the most useful phrase for you? Why?
quiz.explanation: There is no wrong answer. This helps you reflect on what you learned and what will be most useful in your life.

somali.description: Baro is-baranta aasaasiga ah iyo salaanta
objectives: Is-bar dadka: sheeg magacaaga iyo halka aad ka timid
Si edeb leh u salaan qof
Isticmaal jumlado fudud oo 'to be' ah (I am, you are)
Yeelo wada-hadalkaaga Ingiriisi ee ugu horreeya

sections.explanation: Saddexda jumladood oo dhan waxay isticmaalaan 'I am'. Waxaan u isticmaalnaa 'I am' si aan dadka uga sheegno wax nafteena ku saabsan.
Markaad la hadlayso qof kale, waxaan isticmaalnaa 'you are' halkii 'I am'.
'I am' waxaad ku isticmaali kartaa magacaaga, meesha aad ka timid, sida aad dareemayso, iyo waxyaabo kale oo badan oo adiga kugu saabsan.

dialogue: Waxaan ahay Marcus. Waxaan ku noolahay 4C.
Magacaygu waa Ahmed. Waxaan ka soo jeedaa Soomaaliya. Waxaan ku noolahay 4B.
Waxaan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulmay!
Aniguna waxaan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulmay.

vocabulary.definition: dhismo leh qolal, sida dhismo dad badani ku nool yihiin
in aad qof aragto oo aad la hadasho markii ugu horreysay
vocabulary.example: Waan ku faraxsanahay inaan kula kulmo.

vocabulary.definition: salaan soo dhoweyn oo loo jeediyo qof soo gaaraya

drills.instruction: Qof baa su'aal ku weydiinaya. Qor jawaabtaada dhabta ah.
Isticmaal waxa aad ka ogaatay 'I am' iyo 'you are' si aad u dhamaystirtid jumlad kasta.
Isku dar waxaas oo dhan xaalad cusub.

speaking.instruction: Duub adigoo dhihi: 'Hi, my name is [YOUR NAME]. I am from [YOUR PLACE].'
Feker inaad la kulanto Marcus. Duub wada hadalka oo dhan ee sheekada. Adigu waxaad tahay qofka 'You' ee wada hadalka.

writing.instruction: Buuxi jumladahan oo ku saabsan adiga:
Qor wada hadal gaaban (6-8 sadar) oo ay laba qof markii ugu horreysay kulmayaan. Isticmaal weedhaha casharkan.

quiz.1: Qof wuxuu yiraahdaa 'Nice to meet you.' Maxaad tiraahdaa?
quiz.2: Buuxi meesha bannaan: I ___ from Somalia.
quiz.4: Markuu Marcus yiraahdo 'How are you?', maxuu doonaya inuu ogaado?
quiz.5: Waxaad rabto inaad weydiiso dareenka ama xaaladda qof. Maxaad tiraahdaa?
quiz.8: Qor wada hadal 4 sadar ah oo aad kula kulayso qof la yiraahdo Sarah oo ka timid England. Isticmaal weedhaha aad baratay.
quiz.9: Ka fikir casharka. Qor 2-3 jumlood: Waa maxay weedha aad ugu faa'iidaysan? Waa maxay sababta?
